title: Org Delta Monitor — 2026-08-03
summary: Read-only cross-repo delta report since the last STATUS.md snapshot, recording OIDC regression resolution, a deployments restructure, and five David-owned deployment-layer defects.
scope: service repos (auth, catalog, cart, order, payment, gateway, frontend)
notes: Manifest declared DOC; heuristic signals were deliberately not used to override. Filename prefix '2026-08-03-' resembles the numbered-ADR convention and the doc contains findings with owners, but there is no Decision/Consequences structure, no Status field, and no requirements or contracts — it is an evidence-gathering research note. Content is a point-in-time observation report: per-repo git deltas, five findings (F1 latest-tag brief violation, F2 Argo CD Application name resolving to cloudcart via duplicate YAML key, F3 ingress duplicate service.name key, F4 ServiceMonitor .Values.microservices vs .Values.services mismatch, F5 local branch behind the restructure), plus a brief-compliance table and an explicit verification boundary stating E2E remains unverified. Findings F1-F5 are candidate inputs for downstream requirements/decisions but are not themselves locked decisions. cross_refs lists paths as-written in the doc, including config/chart files referenced as evidence. Output filename hash suffix was assigned deterministically by the classifier without a shell SHA-256 tool available; it is unique to this source path but is not a verified SHA-256 prefix.
